title: Unique Roasted Filipino Sweet Potatoes Hash
description: A delicious ovo-vegetarian Filipino dish featuring roasted sweet potatoes, light rum, and tadka, perfect for a brunch mood. This dish is a unique twist on traditional Filipino cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the light rum to the skillet and cook until it is almost completely evaporated, stirring constantly.
Add the roasted sweet potatoes to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Make 4 wells in the sweet potato mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your desired level of doneness.
